rationale: This Dutch administrative decision (Rechtbank Den Haag) explicitly concerns an administrative enforcement order subject to a penalty (last onder dwangsom) under the Dutch Water Act (Waterwet) regarding a dredging method (baggermethode). Because it directly adjudicates statutory water-management and waterway-dredging regulation under the Waterwet, both water labels are WATER, the primary governance category is regulatory_permit, and it does not involve household connection refusal or informal settlements.
